summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py. The new tests plus the existing test/test_path.py run as 40 passed under the prepared venv. mypy, black and isort are not installed in that venv, so type checking and formatting were checked by hand only. Open risk: the non-node guard (isinstance against Node) may be flagged as unreachable under warn_unreachable. The cyclic rdf:rest ValueError path has no test. Changes are uncommitted.
